notes.title: Rustler - Early Access Release and Loyalty Discount
notes.notes:
Dear all!
We are happy to announce the launch of the Early Access version of Rustler!

Owners of this game will get the 25% Loyalty DISCOUNT when buying Rustler!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25944205/fa8c36f50a21edae36bee4e0f8a1dab3d046ec0a.png

Experience feudal injustice, witch-hunting and join big tournaments. Meet valiant, yet incredibly stupid knights. Complete a wide variety of twisted missions and quests... or don’t give a damn about the plot and bring mayhem in the villages and cities. Choose to go on foot or by a stolen horse. Fight with a sword or pick a fancy automatic crossbow. All that spiced up with an inappropriate Monty Python inspired sense of humor!

There's no time to wait - discount is available only till February 24th! Buy Rustler now and ride Your Horse! 🐴

https://store.steampowered.com/app/844260

notes.title: Little patch
notes.notes:
Hello, walkers!

In this little patch we've fixed some little bugs. Thanks our community for finding this.

Changelog:
 Fixed bug with level 2 Blaster energy consumption. Energy consumption was higher than level 1 Blaster.
 Fixed errors in GUI layout for Russian localization.
 Fixed some typos.

notes.title: BE-A Walker: Has Begun - MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear Walkers!

Week after release, we were working hard on game improvement (you even can't imagine how much we've walked....)

Ok, let's not walkaround and jump into changelog :D

Changelog:
 NEW ARCADE MODE (smaller cooldowns, more armor, more enemies)
 Added Autowalk (double tap and hold button), there is a tutorial in the end of the first level
 Removed walker's mode (eco-normal-agressive 'R') from arcade mode.
 On the transporting levels number of people decreases by 30% with every fail.
 Oxygen leak frequency depends on level of difficulty now.
 Added AZERTY keyboard checkbox in controls menu (it is hard to make remapping atm)
 Added marks for the key missions
 Fixed some typos

notes.title: First balance patch.
notes.notes:
Thank you guys for all the reviews and comments, it was invaluable. We released the patch fixing the most important balance issues.

Change log

[olist]
 Blaster cooling time decreased. It depends on difficulty level.
 Reload cooldown of all the weapons reduced
 Turbo-mode (button 'R') works more efficiently now. It helps to reload weapons faster.
 Easy and Normal difficulty: decreased oxygen consumption. Decreased enemy damage.
 Increased efficiency of repair drones.
 Fixed a bug with an absent hangar map section in one of the side mission.
[/olist]
